a_before_b.rationale: Comparing model capabilities based on architecture, size, modality, and performance does not require understanding evaluation standardization issues; one can meaningfully compare models without first grasping why results are hard to compare across studies.

b_before_a.rationale: Understanding the lack of standardization and quality control in evaluation does not depend on being able to compare foundation models by their technical characteristics; the two concepts address different layers of the evaluation landscape.
